floating-imported.ts:
import { loadArea } from "./support";
export function ignored() { loadArea(); }
unsafe-json.ts: export function area(raw: string): number { const value = JSON.parse(raw); return value.area; }
unsafe-call.ts: export function invoke(raw: string) { const callback = JSON.parse(raw); callback(); }
unsafe-argument.ts: export function append(raw: string) { const items: string[] = []; items.push(JSON.parse(raw)); return items; }
async-event.ts: export function listen(button: HTMLButtonElement) { button.addEventListener("click", async () => { await fetch("/api/health"); }); }
switch-missing.ts: export function label(status: "queued" | "running" | "done") { switch (status) { case "queued": return "Waiting"; case "running": return "Working"; } return "Unknown"; }
hook-conditional.tsx:
import { useState } from "react";
export function Conditional({ enabled }: { enabled: boolean }) { if (enabled) useState(0); return null; }
effect-dependencies.tsx:
import { useEffect } from "react";
export function Title({ name }: { name: string }) { useEffect(() => { document.title = name; }, []); return null; }
ref-in-render.tsx: import { useRef } from "react"; export function RefValue() { const ref = useRef(0); return {ref.current}; }
set-state-effect.tsx: import { useEffect, useState } from "react"; export function Initial() { const [count, setCount] = useState(0); useEffect(() => { setCount(1); }, []); return {count}; }
